review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review against the pinned J3/24-007 PDF: doc/source_audits/batch_123.json. The reviewer re-read the original sections (PDF p230-235), re-derived unit hashes rather than accepting the author receipt, and independently recomputed the census. Two blocking findings were closed by correction commit cf1fff9 and re-verified by the same reviewer: C117SR-001 (11.7.4 image-set bounds collapsed the positive, upper-bound and no-repeated-values obligations into single facets, contradicting the packet's own compound sweep) and C117SR-002 (11.7.2 p3 and 11.7.5 p4 were dispositioned permission although each carries normative shall restrictions; both are now split so obligations and latitude are disposed separately). Source accounting only: no fixture was bound, authored_facets is unchanged at 1839, and no executable oracle or runtime credit is claimed. All of 11.7 is image execution control and this suite has no multi-image capability, so synchronization, segment ordering, scheduling and failure-dependent behaviour carry no executable oracle.
